gaps: Section 85.6: 'This inventory is based on confidential information provided by industry sources. The input information may not be divulged.' The BAT-Notes tables are what the report prints; the dataset's exact amounts are not published.
No transport, no chemical-plant infrastructure and no process-water input are quantified in the excerpt.
The report mentions that gypsum can be generated if the acid is neutralised with lime and that filter salts can be sold, but gives no amounts and no allocation, so neither is included.
Several air-emission rows (NOx, H2S) are printed only as ranges with no value marked as used; their midpoints are used and flagged low confidence.
